p.d: निर्देश (प्रश्न 61–65): Read the passage given below and answer the questions that follow by selecting the most appropriate answer.
p.b: Education is the most powerful weapon which you can use to change the world. It is not just about going to school and getting a degree. It is about widening your knowledge and absorbing the truth about life. Education makes a person capable of distinguishing between right and wrong. A well-educated person can contribute significantly to society. However, education should not be limited to books alone. Practical experience and moral values are equally important. Teachers play a vital role in shaping the future of students. They not only impart knowledge but also instill values and discipline. In today's world, education has become more accessible, yet the quality remains a concern. Every child deserves quality education regardless of their background.

p.d: निर्देश (प्रश्न 61–65): Read the passage given below and answer the questions that follow by selecting the most appropriate answer.
p.b: Agriculture is the backbone of the Indian economy. It provides livelihood to a large section of the population. India produces a variety of crops including wheat, rice, cotton, and sugarcane. Modern farming techniques and irrigation have increased productivity. However, farmers face challenges like climate change, water scarcity, and market fluctuations. Sustainable agriculture is essential for food security. The government provides subsidies and support to farmers. Organic farming is gaining popularity as a healthier alternative.

p.d: निर्देश (प्रश्न 61–65): Read the passage given below and answer the questions that follow by selecting the most appropriate answer.
p.b: Health is wealth. A healthy body is essential for a happy and productive life. Regular exercise, balanced diet, and adequate sleep are the pillars of good health. In today's fast-paced world, many people neglect their health due to stress and busy schedules. Junk food and sedentary lifestyle have led to an increase in diseases like obesity, diabetes, and heart problems. It is important to adopt healthy habits from a young age. Schools should promote physical education and healthy eating. A healthy mind resides in a healthy body.

p.d: निर्देश (प्रश्न 66–70): Read the passage given below and answer the questions that follow by selecting the most appropriate option.
p.b: Water is essential for all life on Earth. It covers about 71% of the Earth's surface. However, only a small fraction of this water is fresh and available for human use. Water is used for drinking, agriculture, industry, and many other purposes. Unfortunately, water pollution and overuse have led to water scarcity in many parts of the world. It is our responsibility to conserve water and keep it clean. Simple practices like fixing leaks, using water-efficient appliances, and rainwater harvesting can make a big difference. Every drop of water saved is a step towards a sustainable future.

p.d: निर्देश (प्रश्न 66–70): Read the passage given below and answer the questions that follow by selecting the most appropriate option.
p.b: A hospital is a place where sick and injured people receive medical treatment. Hospitals play a vital role in healthcare and saving lives. They provide emergency services, surgeries, and specialized care. Doctors, nurses, and other medical staff work together to treat patients. Modern hospitals use advanced technology and equipment. Hospitals also conduct research and training for medical professionals. They are essential for public health and community well-being. Every citizen should have access to quality healthcare.

p.d: निर्देश (प्रश्न 66–70): Read the passage given below and answer the questions that follow by selecting the most appropriate option.
p.b: Sports play an important role in the overall development of children. They promote physical fitness, mental alertness, and social skills. Sports teach children about teamwork, discipline, and fair play. Regular participation in sports helps in building confidence and reducing stress. In today's digital age, children spend more time on screens and less time playing outdoors. Schools should encourage sports and physical activities. Sports also teach children how to handle success and failure gracefully. A healthy body leads to a healthy mind.

p.d: निर्देश (प्रश्न 66–70): Read the passage given below and answer the questions that follow by selecting the most appropriate option.
p.b: A library is a treasure house of knowledge. It provides access to books, journals, and digital resources. Libraries play a crucial role in promoting literacy and lifelong learning. They offer a quiet space for study and research. In today's digital age, libraries have adapted by offering e-books and online databases. A good library has a diverse collection catering to different interests and age groups. Librarians guide readers in finding the right resources. Libraries are essential for a well-informed and educated society.

p.d: निर्देश (प्रश्न 66–70): Read the passage given below and answer the questions that follow by selecting the most appropriate option.
p.b: A museum is a place where history comes alive. It preserves artifacts, artworks, and documents of cultural significance. Museums educate visitors about past civilizations, art, and science. They play a vital role in preserving cultural heritage. In today's digital age, many museums offer virtual tours and online exhibitions. Museums inspire curiosity and a love for learning. They are important for research and education. Every child should visit a museum to understand their heritage and history.

p.d: निर्देश (प्रश्न 61–65): Read the passage given below and answer the questions that follow by selecting the most appropriate answer.
p.b: Education is the most powerful weapon which you can use to change the world. It empowers individuals and transforms societies. Education provides knowledge, skills, and values necessary for personal and social development. It promotes equality, justice, and peace. In today's world, education must be inclusive and accessible to all. Quality education is essential for sustainable development. Teachers play a crucial role in shaping the future of students. Education is not just about academic learning; it is about developing critical thinking and problem-solving skills.

p.d: निर्देश (प्रश्न 61–65): Read the passage given below and answer the questions that follow by selecting the most appropriate answer.
p.b: Technology has transformed our lives in countless ways. From smartphones to artificial intelligence, technology has made tasks easier and faster. However, it also brings challenges like privacy concerns, job displacement, and digital divide. It is important to use technology responsibly and ethically. Education must adapt to prepare students for a technology-driven future. While technology can enhance learning, it should not replace human interaction and critical thinking. Balance between technology use and human values is essential for a harmonious society.

p.d: निर्देश (प्रश्न 61–65): Read the passage given below and answer the questions that follow by selecting the most appropriate answer.
p.b: The solar system consists of the Sun and eight planets. The Sun is the center of the solar system and provides light and heat. The planets revolve around the Sun in elliptical orbits. Earth is the third planet from the Sun and the only one known to support life. The solar system also includes moons, asteroids, and comets. The study of the solar system helps us understand our place in the universe. Space exploration has revealed many mysteries of the solar system. Scientists continue to explore and discover new celestial bodies.

p.d: निर्देश (प्रश्न 61–65): Read the passage given below and answer the questions that follow by selecting the most appropriate answer.
p.b: The last great war, which nearly shook the foundations of the modern world, had little impact on Indian Literature beyond aggravating the popular revulsion against violence and adding to the growing disillusionment with the 'humane pretensions of the Western World. This was eloquently voiced in Tagore's later poems and his last testament, Crisis in Civilisation. The Indian Intelligentsia was in a state of moral dilemma. On the one hand, it could not help sympathising with England's dogged courage in the hour of peril, with the Russians fighting with their backs to the wall against the ruthless Nazi hordes, and with China groaning under the heel of Japanese militarism; on the other hand, their own country was practically under military occupation of their own soil, and an Indian army under Subhas Bose was trying from the opposite camp to liberate their country. No creative impulse could issue from such confusion of loyalties. One would imagine that the achievement of Indian Independence in 1947, which came in the wake of the Allies' victory and was followed by the collapse of colonialism in the neighbouring Countries of South-East Asia, would have released an upsurge of creative energy. No doubt it did, but unfortunately it was soon submerged in the great agony of Partition, with its inhuman slaughter of the innocents and the uprooting of millions of people from their homeland followed by the martyrdom of Mahatma Gandhi.

p.d: निर्देश (प्रश्न 61–65): Read the passage given below and answer the questions that follow by selecting the most appropriate answer.
p.b: The internet has revolutionized the way we live, work, and communicate. It has made information accessible to everyone, anywhere, anytime. However, with great power comes great responsibility. The internet also brings challenges like cyberbullying, misinformation, and privacy concerns. It is essential for users to be digitally literate and responsible. Parents and teachers must guide children in using the internet safely. While the internet is a valuable tool for education and entertainment, excessive use can lead to addiction and health problems. Balance is key to harnessing the benefits of the digital age.

p.d: निर्देश (प्रश्न 66–70): Read the passage given below and answer the questions that follow by selecting the most appropriate option.
p.b: A good teacher is not just a source of knowledge but a guide and mentor. Teaching is not merely delivering lectures; it involves understanding each student's unique needs and abilities. A good teacher creates a positive and inclusive classroom environment where every student feels valued. They inspire curiosity and a love for learning. Effective teachers use a variety of teaching methods to cater to different learning styles. They also provide constructive feedback and encourage students to think critically. In today's world, a teacher's role has expanded beyond the classroom to include being a counselor and a role model.

p.d: निर्देश (प्रश्न 66–70): Read the passage given below and answer the questions that follow by selecting the most appropriate option.
p.b: Friendship is one of the most valuable relationships in life. A true friend is someone who stands by you in both good and bad times. Friends share our joys and sorrows, and provide emotional support. True friendship is based on trust, honesty, and mutual respect. In today's digital age, social media has changed the way we make friends, but the essence of friendship remains the same. It is better to have a few true friends than many superficial ones. Friendship teaches us important life skills like empathy, cooperation, and communication.

p.d: निर्देश (प्रश्न 61–65): Read the passage given below and answer the questions that follow by selecting the most appropriate answer.
p.b: Music is a universal language that transcends cultural boundaries. It has the power to evoke emotions and bring people together. Music is used in celebrations, rituals, and healing. Different cultures have their own musical traditions, but the joy of music is shared by all. Music education enhances cognitive development and creativity in children. Playing a musical instrument improves coordination and discipline. Music therapy is used to treat various mental health conditions. In today's world, music is more accessible than ever through digital platforms.

p.d: निर्देश (प्रश्न 66–70): Read the passage given below and answer the questions that follow by selecting the most appropriate option.
p.b: A zoo is a place where wild animals are kept in captivity for public viewing and conservation. Zoos play an important role in wildlife conservation and education. They provide a safe environment for endangered species. Zoos help in breeding programs to increase population of rare animals. Visitors learn about different animals and their habitats. Modern zoos focus on animal welfare and naturalistic enclosures. Zoos also conduct research on animal behavior and health. They inspire people to care about wildlife conservation.

p.d: निर्देश (प्रश्न 66–70): Read the passage given below and answer the questions that follow by selecting the most appropriate option.
p.b: The environment is our life support system. It provides us with air to breathe, water to drink, and food to eat. However, human activities have severely damaged the environment. Deforestation, pollution, and over-exploitation of natural resources have led to climate change and loss of biodiversity. It is our responsibility to protect the environment for future generations. Simple actions like planting trees, reducing waste, and conserving water can make a big difference. Schools play an important role in creating environmental awareness among children. Through activities like nature walks, eco-clubs, and recycling projects, children can learn to appreciate and protect nature.
